xml_doc_impact_assessment.issue: Package Aspose.Slides.NET ships Aspose.Slides.xml but pipeline expects Aspose.Slides.NET.xml (package_id-named xml file).
xml_doc_impact_assessment.source_of_truth_finding: xml_path: null, xml_warning: 'XML documentation not found: Aspose.Slides.NET.xml in .../netstandard2.0'
xml_doc_impact_assessment.dll_status: DLL FOUND — Aspose.Slides.dll resolved via endswith('.NET') fallback. DLL resolution is NOT affected.
xml_doc_impact_assessment.xml_impact_on_reflection: None — DllReflector uses DLL for reflection, not XML. All 5 types and 36 methods enumerated correctly.
xml_doc_impact_assessment.xml_impact_on_api_catalog: Method parameter names and docstrings absent from api-catalog.json. Type/method signatures present (from reflection).
xml_doc_impact_assessment.xml_impact_on_llm_prompts: LLM receives method signatures without parameter descriptions. For simple static methods (ToPdf(string, string)) this is low-risk. For Compress methods taking Presentation objects, LLM may need more explicit per_type_constraints guidance.
xml_doc_impact_assessment.xml_impact_on_generation_quality: LOW for Convert (file-path methods are self-explanatory). MEDIUM for Compress (object mutation pattern less obvious).
resolution_options: Option A (recommended): Accept xml_warning as non-blocking. Use per_type_constraints to supply what XML docs would have described.
Option B: Investigate if Aspose.Slides.xml (without .NET suffix) is present in extracted nupkg dir and add xml fallback for stripped-suffix file. Separate follow-up item.
Option C: Pin to older Aspose.Slides.NET version that ships Aspose.Slides.NET.xml — not recommended (loses latest API).
xml_doc_impact_assessment.recommended_resolution: Option A — accept xml_warning, compensate with detailed per_type_constraints

notes: Slides has 3 WORKFLOW_ROOT types — larger scope than Email (1) but smaller than PDF (4 active).
Convert.ToPdf is the recommended minimal pilot start — static, file-path, %PDF output validation. Lowest LLM error risk.
Compress is the most novel pattern in the entire portfolio — in-place Presentation mutation with explicit Save() requirement. Needs careful per_type_constraints.
Merger pair-fixture strategy mirrors Words.Merger — can reference words.yml merger_input_creation_lines as reference.
slides.yml currently has Compress, Convert, Merger in per_type_constraints but allowed_types: [] — only need to ADD to allowed_types and expand per_type_constraints for activation.
The Collect and ForEach utility types should never be added to allowed_types — they are traversal helpers, not workflow roots.
xml_doc_impact_assessment recommends Option A (accept xml_warning) — no pipeline code change needed for xml fallback before activation.
